svg.title: Patent CN112002313B cited as prior art in unrelated industries
svg.desc: The granted patent CN112002313B, filed May 2019 and granted April 2023 with Zihao Zheng as first inventor, has been cited as prior art by Ping An Life Insurance in a financial-services question-identification filing, and by Tianjin University in a power-transformer load-forecasting filing. Both citations were entered by government patent examiners rather than disclosed by the inventor.
svg.text: Cited as prior art in industries with nothing to do with voice assistants
Both citations were entered by government patent examiners searching for relevant prior art — not disclosed by the inventor.
Filed 9 May 2019 · Granted 7 Apr 2023 · Alibaba Group
Fortune Global 500 · CN112559687B, question identification for advisory

Insurance advisory and power-grid forecasting share no product surface with a smart speaker. When examiners in both fields land on the same architecture, the contribution is general — not a product-specific optimisation.
